chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha and Muhammad ibn Yahya from the executor of Ali ibn al-Sari, who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), 'Indeed, Ali ibn al-Sari died and bequeathed to me.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'May Allah have mercy on him.' I said, 'And his son Ja'far ibn Ali had intercourse with his mother (from another wife), so he ordered me to remove him from the inheritance.' He (peace be upon him) said to me, 'Remove him from the inheritance, and if you are truthful, insanity will befall him.'

He (the narrator) said, 'So I returned and presented myself to Abu Yusuf the Judge. He said to him, 'May Allah rectify you! I am Ja'far ibn Ali ibn al-Sari, and this is the executor of my father. Order him to hand over to me my inheritance from my father.' Abu Yusuf the Judge said to me, 'What do you say?' I said to him, 'Yes, this is Ja'far ibn Ali ibn al-Sari, and I am the executor of Ali ibn al-Sari.' He said, 'Then hand over his wealth to him.' I said, 'I want to speak with you.' He said, 'Approach me.' So I approached where no one could hear my speech, so I said to him, 'This one had intercourse with the mother of his father (his half-brother's mother), so his father ordered me and bequeathed to me to remove him from the inheritance and not to leave him anything. So I went to Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) in Medina, informed him and asked him, so he ordered me to remove him from the inheritance and not to leave him anything.' He said, 'By Allah, did Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) order you?' I said, 'Yes.' He made me swear an oath three times, then said to me, 'Execute what Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) ordered you with, for his word is the word.'
The executor said, 'So insanity befall him after that.' Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha said, 'So I saw him after that, and insanity had indeed befallen him.'

key_terms.أُمِّ وَلَدٍ: Mother from concubinage (a female slave who bore her master's child)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on removing a son from inheritance if he had intercourse with his father's concubine?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the principle of 'al-qawl qawluhu' (the word of the Imam is decisive) in Shia jurisprudence, where the Imam's specific instruction to exclude the son from inheritance overrides standard legal presumptions. The narrative highlights the practical application of penalizing specific moral transgressions, such as intercourse with one's own umm walad, by disinheritance, a ruling confirmed by Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS). The subsequent occurrence of 'khalal' (insanity or physical/mental affliction) serves as a divine sign validating the Imam's authority and the truthfulness of the executor's report.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from and executor Ali Bin Al Sary who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> that Ali Bin Al-Sary died, so he bequeathed to me’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy upon him’. I said, ‘And (the responsibility of) his son Ja’far Bin Ali fell upon his mother. So he ordered me that I should take him out from the inheritance’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Take him out from the inheritance, and if what you said was true, so he would be hit by insanity’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So I returned, and he took me to Abu Yusuf, the judge. So he said to him, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you well! I am Ja’far Bin Ali Bin Al-Sary, and this is the executor of my father, therefore order him to hand over to me my inheritance from my father’. So Abu Yusuf the Judge said to me, ‘What are you saying?’ So I said to him, ‘Yes, this is Ja’far Bin Ali Bin Al-Sary, and I am an executor of Ali Bin Al-Sary’. He said, ‘So hand over to him, his wealth’. So I said, ‘I want to speak with you’. He said, ‘So approach me’. So I approached where no one could hear my speech, so I said to him, ‘This one (his responsibility) has fallen upon the mother who gave birth for his father, so his father ordered me and bequeathed to me that I should take him out from the inheritance, and not let him inherit anything. So I went over to Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> at Al-Medina, so I informed him<sup>asws</sup> and asked him, so he<sup>asws</sup> ordered me that I should take him out from the inheritance, and not to let him inherit anything’. So he said, ‘(By) Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> ordered you?’ I said, ‘Yes’. So he made me swear an oath three times, then said to me, ‘Enforce what Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> ordered you with, so the (true) words are his<sup>asws</sup> words’.
The executor said, ‘So the insanity hit him after that. Abu Muhammad Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washa said, ‘So I saw him after that, and the insanity had indeed hit him’.
en.sarwar: 15. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ Ahmad Muhammad ibn Yahya from Wasiy of Ali ibn al-Sariy who has narrated the following:

“I once said to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that Ali ibn al-Sariy has died and has made a will to me. He (the Imam) said, ‘May Allah grant him mercy.’ I then said that his son, Ja‘far ibn Ali, has fallen on a mother of his child. He has instructed me not to allow him receive anything from the legacy. He (the narrator) has said that he (the Imam) said, ‘Do not give him anything from the legacy. If what you say is true, he will soon be affected by confusion.’

He (the narrator) has said, ‘I returned and he took me before abu Yusuf, the judge and said to him, “May Allah keep you well, I am Ja‘far son of Ali ibn al-Sariy and this is the executor of the will of my father. Please command him to give to me legacy of my father.” Abu Yusuf, the judge said to me, “What do you say?” I said to him, “Yes, this is Ja‘far ibn Ali al-Sariy and I am the executor of the will of Ali ibn al-Sariy.” He said, “Give him his inheritance.” I said, “I like to speak to you.” He said, “Come close.” I went close to him so that no one could hear my words and said to him, “This has fallen on the mother of the child of his father. His father made a will not to give him anything from the legacy. I asked Musa ibn abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, in al-Madinah, informed him about it and asked him. He (the Imam) instructed me not to allow him to receive any inheritance.” He said, “Allah, abu al-Hassan, has commanded you?” He (the narrator) has said that I said, “Yes, he (the Imam) has commanded me to do so.” He (the judge) made me to swear three times then he said, “Execute what abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has commanded to do because the word is his words.”’
The executor of the will has said, ‘He became confused thereafter.’ Abu Muhammad al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ has said, ‘I saw him afterward and he had become confused.’”
